name: ZyLab
one_liner: ZyLab provides AI tools and services to generate product photos, promo videos, and audio content for digital marketing.
what_you_sell: AI-powered media generation software for product photography, promotional videos, and podcasts, alongside done-for-you content creation services and training cohorts.
target_group: ZyLab sells to e-commerce brands and marketing agencies with under 50 employees that need a continuous volume of visual marketing assets. Good prospects frequently launch products or run video ad campaigns on social channels and need studio-quality visuals without traditional production overhead. They buy either access to the AI platform or direct agency support.
who_uses_it: E-commerce managers, social media marketers, graphic designers, and content creators.
who_pays_for_it: E-commerce brand owners, digital agency directors, and marketing leaders.
who_buys_it: E-commerce brands and marketing agencies that require frequent visual content and product media.
_claims_to_check: implies availability of an active creator network ('créateur Dinzy') for full delegation
implies an active two-week training cohort program
implies integration of advanced video models like 'Seedance 2.5'
